# Delivery context

Two regions, regionA and regionB, are to be delivered for expression exploration and morphology review. The region README files describe the intended count representation. The supplied shared-folder inventory was generated by a complete metadata scan of the shared folder. The original instrument outputs/drives have not been inspected; this inventory is not a statement that the shared folder itself is complete.

The downloaded copy is in received/. Use the inventory as the current baseline; its source directory is outside this task and should not be searched. The separate sender checksum list was received with the correspondence; it has not been checked against the local copy. No content verification has been requested.
